verdict.rationale: Digits advertises real-time integrations with 12,000+ financial institutions and names specific connectors for payroll (Gusto), payments (Stripe), and spend (Ramp). It claims live connected data that is auto-booked: 95%+ of transactions are booked in real time, and financial activity is collected continuously into the ledger. The help center also covers adding new connections. Missing for 10: per-connector documentation (setup steps, sync frequency, how payroll and payment data map to ledger entries) and independent or hands-on corroboration that these connections flow through automatically.
